title: When the Language Sings
author: Isandro Eastwick
blurb: Oscar Nystrom, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
